title: Broadscale reconnaissance of coral reefs from citizen science and deep learning.
summary: ~29,967 Great Barrier Reef images from citizen scientists; AI-alone and AI+citizen labels compared with experts. For 8,086 images, best method was category-specific; estimated coral-cover errors were small for several categories, but "other coral" accuracy was weaker. This is an empirical field-monitoring result. The result is limited to this study setting and is not evidence of benefit in deployment.
ai_technology: Deep-learning image classifiers labeled citizen-science reef images, alone and with citizen labels, for comparison with expert annotations.
